title: Shockwave Medical AT CIRSE 2026
clientLabel: Shockwave Medical, part of Johnson & Johnson
summary: KOL filming and VR deployment at CIRSE Copenhagen 2026 for the Shockwave Medical Peripheral Team.
body:
At CIRSE 2026 we worked with Johnson & Johnson’s Shockwave Medical team on filming and VR support across three days of the congress.

In Shockwave’s Experience Centre we recorded physicians talking about the clinical evidence behind IVL. That included multiple interviews with physicians. We also captured two clinical case recordings, each with a single physician. Each recording used a lit, three-camera set-up.

Alongside the filming, our team helped Shockwave run their VR programme, handling VR delivery and hardware across 10 sessions over the congress.

CIRSE is part of our long-standing work with Shockwave Medical, now part of Johnson & Johnson, across European and US congresses.
